text.name: input_CINE_RECORD
text.text: Cinema Studio: record a vehicle drive or a walk (on / off)

text.name: cine_rec_noVehicle
text.text: Cinema Studio: cannot record here, get into a vehicle or out of it

text.name: cine_rec_tooShortWalk
text.text: Cinema Studio: the character barely moved and did nothing, the recording was not kept

text.name: cine_rec_tooShort
text.text: Cinema Studio: the vehicle barely moved, recording discarded

text.name: cine_rec_done
text.text: Cinema Studio: recording %s (%.0f s) is waiting, open the editor

text.name: cine_msg_recImported
text.text: Recording added: %s, %.0f s, %d route points, %d actions

text.name: input_CINE_KEY_ADD
text.text: Cinema Studio: K-frame into the block under the playhead

text.name: input_CINE_KEY_BACKSPACE
text.text: Cinema Studio: delete selected and leave the gap (the camera holds in it)

text.name: input_CINE_KEY_DELETE
text.text: Cinema Studio: delete selected and close the gap

text.name: input_CINE_KEY_PREV
text.text: Cinema Studio: previous K-frame or block edge

text.name: input_CINE_KEY_NEXT
text.text: Cinema Studio: next K-frame or block edge

text.name: input_CINE_KEY_RAISE
text.text: Cinema Studio: row up (with Ctrl raise K-frame)

text.name: input_CINE_KEY_LOWER
text.text: Cinema Studio: row down (with Ctrl lower K-frame)

text.name: input_CINE_RESET_ACTORS
text.text: Cinema Studio: vehicles back to start

text.name: input_CINE_CYCLE_TARGET
text.text: Cinema Studio: draw camera path / vehicle route

text.name: input_CINE_GRID
text.text: Cinema Studio: rule of thirds grid

text.name: cine_status_topdown
text.text: Top-down: %s | new point height %.0f m (Ctrl + Shift + wheel) | Tab switches

text.name: cine_msg_keyCut
text.text: Cut: a new block starts at the current pose (Shift + G overwrites the end of the previous one)

text.name: cine_msg_onlyShot
text.text: There is only one shot (N creates another)

text.name: cine_msg_shotDeleted
text.text: Shot removed from the list (the file stays in modSettings)

text.name: cine_msg_targetMissing
text.text: The tracked vehicle is not in this game

text.name: cine_msg_notDrivable
text.text: This vehicle cannot drive by itself (pick the tractor)

text.name: cine_msg_actorAdded
text.text: %s: click the route on the ground, start position is remembered

text.name: cine_msg_actorNoStart
text.text: The vehicle has no remembered start

text.name: cine_msg_actorMissing
text.text: A vehicle of this shot is not in this game

text.name: cine_msg_actorNotServer
text.text: Only the game host can drive vehicles

text.name: cine_msg_actorOccupied
text.text: You are sitting in the vehicle - get out so it can drive

text.name: cine_msg_actorAi
text.text: A helper drives the vehicle - stop it first

text.name: cine_follow_camera
text.text: From where the camera is now

text.name: cine_msg_lookOn
text.text: Mouse look (F brings the cursor back)

text.name: cine_msg_startPoint
text.text: The first point is the vehicle position - Remember start moves it

text.name: cine_msg_pickPoint
text.text: Click a route point (right click on a point deletes it)

text.name: cine_msg_noVehicleCameras
text.text: The vehicle has no cameras of its own

text.name: cine_msg_pairNone
text.text: No second target – add another vehicle or character to the shot

text.name: cine_add_g_onboard
text.text: The camera rides on the vehicle

text.name: cine_add_g_stand
text.text: The camera stands by the road

text.name: cine_add_pass_d
text.text: low by the road, the target drives past

text.name: cine_add_parallel_d
text.text: rides beside the target, does not turn with it

text.name: cine_add_topdown_d
text.text: looks straight down over the target

text.name: cine_add_mount_d
text.text: on the vehicle where the camera is

text.name: cine_msg_needVehicle
text.text: This works only on a vehicle

text.name: cine_menu_shiftClear
text.text: Clear block camera offset (back to the mode)

text.name: cine_mode_static
text.text: Static camera (stays and holds the framing)

text.name: cine_menu_constant
text.text: Constant speed for the whole shot

text.name: cine_menu_trackRestart
text.text: Restart the mode from the camera position

text.name: cine_menu_playAll
text.text: Play all shots in a row

text.name: cine_menu_playFromHere
text.text: Play this shot and all following

text.name: cine_menu_rememberStart
text.text: Remember start where it stands now

text.name: cine_msg_noFillUnits
text.text: The vehicle has nothing to fill

text.name: cine_menu_rememberState
text.text: Update vehicle state (tanks, box, dirt…), keep the position

text.name: cine_msg_stateRemembered
text.text: The vehicle state was saved with the start – reset and playback now restore it

text.name: cine_menu_lookAt
text.text: Aim the camera at the object (from the playhead time)

text.name: cine_menu_focusFree
text.text: Stop aiming from the current time

text.name: cine_menu_pointDefault
text.text: This point only: speed same as the route

text.name: cine_menu_fromFaster
text.text: From this point on (step %d km/h): %.0f km/h

text.name: cine_menu_fromDefault
text.text: From this point on: speed same as the route

text.name: cine_menu_focusFreeHere
text.text: Free look from this point (follow the K-frames)

text.name: cine_msg_focusRow
text.text: Point of interest row: right-click the row to add a point (target from the list or the scene).

text.name: cine_menu_focusChange
text.text: Change target - pick in the scene

text.name: cine_menu_focusFrom
text.text: From the playhead (%.1f s) another target - pick in the scene

text.name: cine_menu_focusCut
text.text: Cut at the playhead (%.1f s) - free view after

text.name: cine_msg_pickFocus
text.text: Click the vehicle the camera should aim at, or the ground, a house, tree or bridge (a point in space).

text.name: cine_msg_focusSplitNot
text.text: The playhead must be inside the point of interest section (not at its edge).

text.name: cine_msg_focusCut
text.text: Aiming cut, free view from here.

text.name: cine_msg_focusSet
text.text: From %.1f s the camera aims at: %s

text.name: cine_msg_focusFree
text.text: From %.1f s the camera in a flight looks along its K-frames

text.name: cine_msg_pointHere
text.text: There is already a route point at this time (or it is off the route)

text.name: cine_msg_segmentSet
text.text: Block %s from %.1f s to %.1f s (right button on the block = settings)

text.name: cine_msg_segmentBusy
text.text: There is another mode at this time; move the playhead or shorten the mode

text.name: cine_msg_actorAddedStatic
text.text: %s: the vehicle does not drive, it is only used for actions

text.name: cine_msg_actionAdded
text.text: Action "%s" at %.1f s from the vehicle start

text.name: cine_msg_spanCurve
text.text: The leg speed is driven by the speed curve (panel V)

text.name: cine_msg_spanExit
text.text: The leg starts with leaving a vehicle: move the Get out action

text.name: cine_msg_spanSplitOutside
text.text: The playhead is not inside the selected leg

text.name: cine_menu_pointReverse
text.text: Leg to this point: reverse (rear first)

text.name: cine_menu_pointForward
text.text: Leg to this point: drive forward (now reversing)

text.name: cine_msg_cannotReverse
text.text: A vehicle with a towed trailer or wheeled implement cannot reverse along a route

text.name: input_CINE_DOCK
text.text: Cinema Studio: side panel (left / right / off)

text.name: cine_msg_dock_left
text.text: Side panel on the left (to click: cursor with F or Alt)

text.name: cine_msg_dock_right
text.text: Side panel on the right (to click: cursor with F or Alt)

text.name: cine_msg_markAdded
text.text: K-frame in the mode at %.1f s: drag it along the block, Shift + wheel over it changes zoom, Ctrl + wheel the speed

text.name: cine_msg_markExists
text.text: There already is a K-frame here

text.name: cine_msg_markNoSpeed
text.text: This mode does not move along a path, its K-frames change zoom only

text.name: cine_hd_mark
text.text: A K-frame inside a mode (orbit, helix, follow…) only carries zoom and motion speed, the mode sets the camera position; drag its marker along the block, Shift + wheel over it changes zoom, Ctrl + wheel the speed, Delete removes it

text.name: cine_ch_aimX
text.text: Point of interest: frame position horizontal

text.name: cine_ch_aimY
text.text: Point of interest: frame position vertical

text.name: cine_ch_clearSpeed
text.text: Remove the curve (back to route point speeds)

text.name: cine_ch_empty
text.text: Click into the graph to create the first point. The current course is kept.

text.name: cine_ch_hint
text.text: click = new point, drag = time and value, right click = point mode, Delete = remove

text.name: input_CINE_CAM_SYNC
text.text: Cinema Studio: return the camera to the timeline pose at the playhead

text.name: cine_msg_camManual
text.text: Camera set by hand: moving the playhead leaves it, Z returns it to the timeline pose.

text.name: input_CINE_SPLIT
text.text: Cinema Studio: split the block at the playhead

text.name: cine_msg_snapOn
text.text: Snapping on (hold Shift while dragging to turn it off)

text.name: cine_msg_editMode_insert
text.text: Edit mode: insert (following blocks move aside)

text.name: cine_msg_editMode_overwrite
text.text: Edit mode: overwrite (overlapped blocks are trimmed)

text.name: cine_msg_splitNot
text.text: This mode can only be split where its progress does not matter (follow, look from a point, static camera)

text.name: cine_msg_splitTooShort
text.text: The playhead is too close to the block edge (each part needs at least 1 s)

text.name: cine_msg_replaceNeedsTarget
text.text: This block has no vehicle to aim the new mode at

text.name: cine_menu_blockRipple
text.text: Cut out and close the gap

text.name: cine_hs_edit
text.text: Editing clips on the timeline (the same rules for everything)

text.name: cine_hk_sel
text.text: click, Shift + click, drag on empty space

text.name: cine_hd_sel
text.text: select, add to / remove from the selection, rectangle selection; a click on empty space clears it

text.name: cine_hd_move
text.text: moves the whole selection (blocks with their K-frames, focus points, actions, vehicle drives); an overlapped block is trimmed or pushed according to O

text.name: cine_hd_trim
text.text: trims the block from either side (grab the edge above or below the K-frames), the other end stays; a shortened flight keeps its motion and gets a K-frame at the edge

text.name: cine_hd_copy
text.text: copies the selection to a new place

text.name: cine_hd_snap
text.text: snapping to the edges of things, the playhead and zero; Shift turns it off while dragging

text.name: cine_hd_editmode
text.text: edit mode: overwrite (overlapped parts are trimmed) / insert (following ones move aside)

text.name: cine_hd_split
text.text: split the block at the playhead (flight, follow, spotlight, static camera)

text.name: cine_hd_ripple
text.text: delete and leave the gap: the camera holds its last pose in it (Delete closes the gap)

text.name: cine_menu_pinOff
text.text: Actions when the run is moved: move with it

text.name: cine_menu_pinOn
text.text: Actions when the run is moved: stay in place

text.name: cine_tb_play_h
text.text: Play from the playhead, press again to stop (Space)

text.name: cine_tb_playStart_h
text.text: Play from the start of the shot (Enter)

text.name: cine_tb_playAll_h
text.text: Play all shots in a row from the first to the last

text.name: cine_tb_snap_h
text.text: Snapping while dragging (J); hold Shift while dragging to turn it off

text.name: cine_tb_mode_h
text.text: Edit mode: overwrite overlapped blocks, or insert and push the following ones aside (O)

text.name: cine_tb_split_h
text.text: Split the block at the playhead (U)

text.name: cine_tb_delete_h
text.text: Delete selected and close the gap (Delete); Backspace leaves the gap and the camera holds in it

text.name: cine_tb_action_h
text.text: Add a camera at the playhead: orbit, follow, static camera…

text.name: cine_tb_actionPerson_h
text.text: Add a character action at the playhead: get in, get out, carry an item…

text.name: cine_tb_actionObj_h
text.text: Add an object action at the playhead: gate, lights, production, hose…

text.name: cine_tb_more_h
text.text: Clipboard, side panel and step history

text.name: cine_tb_info_h
text.text: Editor status: blocks, focal length, flight speed, what you control, speeds at the playhead

text.name: cine_hint_expandAll
text.text: click: expand all rows (vehicle actions, props, objects, points of interest)

text.name: cine_hint_collapseAll
text.text: click: collapse all rows (camera and main rows stay)

text.name: input_CINE_KEY_PASS
text.text: Cinema Studio: pass through the K-frame (smooth / stop / corner)

text.name: cine_msg_passNoKey
text.text: Select a flight K-frame or put the playhead on one

text.name: cine_pass_auto_d
text.text: curve through the points, no speed jump

text.name: cine_pass_corner_d
text.text: straight into the point and out of it

text.name: cine_menu_keyCurveAuto
text.text: Automatic path at the K-frame (remove handles)

text.name: cine_span_stops
text.text: Point to point (stop at both ends)

text.name: cine_profile_uniform
text.text: Uniform - inner K-frames rotation only (times follow speed)

text.name: cine_menu_keyFree
text.text: Rotation only - speed and time set by neighbouring K-frames

text.name: cine_msg_keyFree
text.text: Rotation-only K-frame: its time and speed come from the neighbouring K-frames. Give it its own time again in its menu.

text.name: cine_profile_easeInOut
text.text: Slow start and slow end (moves K-frame times)

text.name: cine_profile_accelerate
text.text: Start from standstill, then steady speed (moves K-frame times)

text.name: cine_profile_decelerate
text.text: Steady speed, then stop (moves K-frame times)

text.name: cine_curve_hump
text.text: speed bump - try Flight speed profile

text.name: cine_hint_curveHandle
text.text: drag sideways: how long the ease in / out takes | Shift both sides | right button default

text.name: cine_hd_pass
text.text: cycle how the camera passes the selected K-frame: smooth, stop, corner (straight)

text.name: cine_hd_free
text.text: Rotation only: the K-frame has no time or speed of its own, the camera passes it smoothly. Whole flight: block menu, Flight speed profile, Uniform

text.name: cine_hd_easeHandle
text.text: on the speed curve drag sideways for the length of the ease in and out; Shift both sides

text.name: cine_hd_pathHandle
text.text: from above, the selected K-frame's handles bend the path; Ctrl makes a corner, right button restores the curve

text.name: cine_top_shot_h
text.text: Shot and its position · click opens the shot menu

text.name: cine_top_reset_h
text.text: Return vehicles to start and the playhead to the beginning · R

text.name: cine_top_vehAt_h
text.text: Place vehicles where they will be at the playhead time · B

text.name: cine_top_follow_h
text.text: Vehicles follow the playhead: they stand where they will be at that time (off = only a marker on the route)

text.name: cine_msg_followOff
text.text: Vehicles stay put, only a marker on the route.

text.name: cine_top_topdown_h
text.text: Top-down view for planning the camera path and vehicle routes · M

text.name: cine_top_pick_h
text.text: Pick an object in the scene: actions around it, aim at it, add a vehicle · T

text.name: cine_top_cross_h
text.text: Crosshair in the middle of the view; with a person or vehicle selected it shows where a right-click route point lands (while looking around with F)

text.name: cine_top_clean_h
text.text: Hide the editor and show a clean picture; H or Esc brings it back · H

text.name: cine_top_env_h
text.text: Time of day, season and weather applied on playback

text.name: cine_top_camera_h
text.text: Shot cameras: switch, new, delete · C switches

text.name: cine_top_save_h
text.text: Save the shot · Ctrl + S (also saved continuously)

text.name: cine_top_help_h
text.text: All keys and what they do · F1

text.name: cine_tb_zoomOut_h
text.text: Zoom the timeline out · Alt + wheel

text.name: cine_tb_zoomIn_h
text.text: Zoom the timeline in · Alt + wheel

text.name: cine_tb_key_h
text.text: K-frame at the playhead: position and zoom in a Flight, zoom in a mode, extends the Flight in a gap · K

text.name: cine_tb_again_h
text.text: Last added action, again at the playhead

text.name: cine_tb_actionVeh_h
text.text: Add a vehicle action at the playhead: lights, beacon, tools…

text.name: cine_add_foot
text.text: Esc closes · a new action squeezes into the gap after the playhead

text.name: cine_add_g_auto
text.text: The camera moves around the target by itself

text.name: cine_add_follow_d
text.text: drives behind, beside or in front of the target

text.name: cine_add_dronie_d
text.text: flies away and up, looking back

text.name: cine_add_approach_d
text.text: flies in to the target from afar

text.name: cine_add_boomerang_d
text.text: an oval around the target and back

text.name: cine_add_flight_d
text.text: free path, rotation from the K-frames

text.name: cine_add_spotlight_d
text.text: follows the K-frames and aims at the target

text.name: cine_add_static_d
text.text: where the free camera is, no target

text.name: cine_add_lookAt_d
text.text: the Flight aims at the target from the playhead

text.name: cine_msg_pickTarget
text.text: Click the object that becomes the action target (Esc cancels)

text.name: cine_help_close
text.text: F1, Esc or a click closes

text.name: cine_tb_curves_h
text.text: Curve panel: zoom, speed and axes (V)

text.name: cine_tb_big_h
text.text: Bigger timeline: three times more room for actor rows (again = back)

text.name: cine_msg_rowsBig
text.text: Timeline enlarged: more actor rows at once.

text.name: cine_tb_advance_h
text.text: What G does: playhead stays, or jumps one step ahead and the flight extends to it (click = toggle)

text.name: cine_tb_advanceStep_h
text.text: How many seconds to jump after G: presets or enter your own

text.name: cine_msg_advanceOn
text.text: After G the playhead jumps %s s ahead and the flight extends.

text.name: cine_msg_advanceOff
text.text: After G the playhead stays put.

text.name: cine_msg_advanceBad
text.text: The step must be a number of seconds, e.g. 2 or 1.5.

text.name: cine_objects_hint
text.text: right click on a row: action at playhead; drag a marker in time

text.name: cine_objects_empty
text.text: no objects: add gates, buildings and machines with T or right click

text.name: cine_object_noActions
text.text: no actions: right click = add action at playhead

text.name: cine_object_addAction
text.text: Add with action at playhead (%.1f s)

text.name: cine_msg_pickObject
text.text: Click a gate, a building with lights or production, or a machine.

text.name: cine_msg_noObject
text.text: No gate, building or machine here.

text.name: cine_msg_objectAlready
text.text: That object is already on the timeline.

text.name: cine_msg_objectAdded
text.text: Object %s is on the timeline; right click its row to add an action.

text.name: cine_hint_objects
text.text: click the arrow: collapse / expand, right click: group menu, drag the name: move

text.name: cine_hint_object
text.text: right click: action at playhead, point camera, remove

text.name: cine_hint_objAction
text.text: drag: move in time (Shift fine), right click: duration, move, delete

text.name: cine_hose_connectFirst
text.text: connect it in the game first, the action remembers the connection

text.name: cine_hint_rowDrag
text.text: drag the name up or down: moves the row

text.name: cine_hint_key
text.text: click selects | drag moves within the block | Ctrl + wheel speed | Shift + wheel zoom | right button menu

text.name: cine_hint_block
text.text: click select (again: piece between K-frames) | drag move (O overwrite / insert) | U split | right button settings

text.name: cine_hint_mark
text.text: click select | drag along the block | Shift + wheel zoom | Ctrl + wheel speed

text.name: cine_hint_focus
text.text: click select | drag in time | right button menu

text.name: cine_hint_action
text.text: click select | drag move (Ctrl copy) | the handle at the end changes the length

text.name: cine_hint_drive
text.text: click select | drag moves the vehicle run with its actions (vehicle menu: actions stay in place)

text.name: cine_hint_routePoint
text.text: click selects the point | right button point menu

text.name: cine_hint_empty
text.text: click clears the selection | drag selects a rectangle | Shift adds

text.name: cine_hint_ruler
text.text: click and drag move the playhead (snaps to edges and K-frames, not with Shift) | middle button pans the timeline

text.name: cine_hint_playheadMode
text.text: click toggles whether only the ruler moves the playhead, or clicking and dragging blocks and K-frames too

text.name: cine_hint_collapse
text.text: collapse / expand the actions of the vehicle

text.name: cine_hint_compact
text.text: collapse / expand all: action lanes of every vehicle and the focus row (camera and vehicles stay)

text.name: cine_hint_rowScroll
text.text: vehicle rows that do not fit: drag here or use the wheel over the rows to scroll

text.name: input_CINE_COPY
text.text: Cinema Studio: copy the selected things on the timeline

text.name: input_CINE_PASTE
text.text: Cinema Studio: paste the copied things at the playhead

text.name: cine_msg_clipboardEmpty
text.text: The clipboard is empty (select things on the timeline and copy them)

text.name: cine_msg_nothingToPaste
text.text: Nowhere to paste (actions need a vehicle)

text.name: cine_tb_copy_h
text.text: Copy the selected things (,); works between shots too

text.name: cine_tb_paste_h
text.text: Paste the copied things at the playhead (.); actions into the selected vehicle

text.name: cine_hd_part
text.text: switches between the whole block and the piece between K-frames under the cursor (flight, follow, spotlight, static camera); a piece can be moved, copied, deleted or taken out as its own block, Shift adds neighbouring pieces

text.name: cine_hd_history
text.text: list of steps; click a step to return the shot to its state (undoable), the wheel scrolls; steps are kept for a week, also after restarting the game

text.name: cine_hd_clip
text.text: copy the selected things and paste them at the playhead (also into another shot)

text.name: cine_msg_playOccupied
text.text: Playback not started: you are sitting in %s - get out, the vehicle is meant to drive by itself

text.name: cine_menu_autoZoomOn
text.text: Auto zoom: on (the vehicle keeps its size)

text.name: cine_menu_autoZoomOff
text.text: Auto zoom: off (click to turn on)

text.name: cine_menu_detailOff
text.text: Vehicle detail: back to all vehicles

text.name: cine_menu_resetHere
text.text: Vehicles to their position at the playhead

text.name: cine_msg_actorsResetHere
text.text: Vehicles placed where they are at %.1f s.

text.name: cine_msg_detailOn
text.text: Vehicle detail %s (X brings all vehicles back)

text.name: cine_msg_detailNone
text.text: Detail needs at least one vehicle on the timeline.

text.name: input_CINE_RESET_HERE
text.text: Cinema Studio: vehicles to the playhead position

text.name: cine_msg_pickCarry
text.text: Click the object the person picks up (pallet, canister, map crate…)

text.name: cine_msg_noCarry
text.text: Nothing here can be picked up

text.name: cine_menu_bankOff
text.text: Banking into turns: off (click to turn on)

text.name: input_CINE_PLAY_TIMELINE
text.text: Cinema Studio: timeline during playback (show / hide)

text.name: cine_hd_look
text.text: look around; F or Alt turns the cursor on

text.name: cine_hd_lens
text.text: camera zoom: the block under the cursor, else the focal length at the playhead; 1–8 lenses 14–400 mm

text.name: cine_hd_key
text.text: K-frame into the block under the playhead, never splits it: in a flight the camera pose and focal length, in other blocks after flying away or turning the whole block camera (position, direction, focal length), otherwise a focal K-frame; in a gap it extends the previous flight or starts a new one

text.name: cine_hd_prevnext
text.text: playhead one whole second back / forward

text.name: cine_hd_raise
text.text: controlled row up / down (also while flying); with Ctrl raise / lower the selected K-frame or standing camera (Shift coarse)

text.name: cine_hk_scrub
text.text: click and drag on the timeline

text.name: cine_hd_scrub
text.text: move in time; dragging a K-frame moves it in time within its block

text.name: cine_hd_step
text.text: previous / next K-frame, block start or end on the controlled row

text.name: cine_hd_delete
text.text: delete the selection (blocks, K-frames, actions, focus points); after a block the gap closes and what follows moves forward

text.name: cine_hd_play
text.text: play / pause; Enter from the start with pre-roll

text.name: cine_hd_playtl
text.text: during playback shows / hides the timeline

text.name: cine_hd_curves
text.text: channels panel: list of ranged values on the left (zoom, vehicle speed from 0 to the machine maximum, arm axes), eye = show the curve; graph of the selected channel on the right: click = new point, drag = time and value, right click on a point = lines / steps / curve, Delete removes; route point marks on top

text.name: cine_hd_bwheel
text.text: Ctrl + wheel: speed of the K-frame or length of the block under the cursor (a flight speeds up as a whole), for a vehicle the route section; otherwise under the playhead of the active row

text.name: cine_hd_bspeed
text.text: zoom the timeline in / out around the cursor (without a cursor around the playhead)

text.name: cine_hd_bease
text.text: ease in (left half) / ease out (right half)

text.name: cine_hd_blen
text.text: block length; a flight keeps its motion (shortening adds a K-frame at the edge)

text.name: cine_hd_pick
text.text: pick an object: mode from the playhead, aim at it, vehicle with a route

text.name: cine_hd_topdown
text.text: top view: click adds a path point, drag sets the direction

text.name: cine_hd_route
text.text: click adds, drag moves, right click or Delete removes

text.name: cine_hk_actions
text.text: right click on a vehicle row

text.name: cine_hd_home
text.text: vehicles to the playhead position / to start

text.name: cine_hd_cursor
text.text: turns the cursor on and off

text.name: cine_hd_close
text.text: stop, close menu, picking or the editor

text.name: cine_msg_segmentSqueezed
text.text: The block fits the gap before the next block (shortened).

text.name: cine_msg_segmentOverwrote
text.text: The block overwrote the start of the next block.

text.name: cine_menu_dropHere
text.text: Restart in place (1 m above ground, then falls)

text.name: cine_msg_pickTeleport
text.text: Click where to put the things. Wheel rotates (Shift fine), right button or Esc cancels.

text.name: cine_box_tb_h
text.text: Box for things in the world: vehicles, sets, pallets and bales move elsewhere with their cargo, keeping their layout

text.name: cine_box_pick
text.text: Add to the box - click in the scene (again = take out)

text.name: cine_box_clear
text.text: Empty the box (things stay where they are)

text.name: cine_msg_boxPick
text.text: Click the vehicles and bales to move. Esc or T ends picking.

text.name: cine_msg_boxEmpty
text.text: The box is empty or its things are not in the world.

text.name: cine_msg_boxPlaced
text.text: Moved: %d. They will drop to the ground.

text.name: cine_hd_drop
text.text: moves the vehicle or the set to a clicked place or restarts it in place; physics then lets it drop

text.name: cine_hd_lanes
text.text: jump between route points, action and drive starts and ends (like camera K-frames)

text.name: cine_hk_camline
text.text: top view: click on the camera path line

text.name: cine_hd_camline
text.text: inserts a K-frame right on the flight path (the motion stays the same)

text.name: input_CINE_SPEED_UP
text.text: Cinema Studio: block speed at the playhead + (faster)

text.name: input_CINE_SPEED_DOWN
text.text: Cinema Studio: block speed at the playhead − (slower)

text.name: cine_hd_blockspeed
text.text: speeds up or slows down the block under the playhead (a flight with its K-frames, a mode by its length); step by the speed step

text.name: cine_msg_noBlockAtPlayhead
text.text: There is no camera block under the playhead.

text.name: cine_hd_eye
text.text: shows or hides the camera or vehicle route in the world and in the top view (crossed out = hidden); a hidden route can not be grabbed or clicked into

text.name: input_CINE_CAMERA_NEXT
text.text: Cinema Studio: next camera of the shot

text.name: cine_msg_onlyCamera
text.text: The shot has only one camera.

text.name: cine_hd_camera
text.text: switches to the shot's next camera (each has its own blocks and focus points; vehicles are shared); right button on the row name offers switching, a new camera and deleting one; shots are saved with the savegame

text.name: cine_menu_addAction
text.text: Add a camera action from the playhead time

text.name: cine_msg_pickForAction
text.text: Click the object the camera should work around (Esc cancels)

text.name: cine_msg_noDriverSeat
text.text: This vehicle has no driver seat

text.name: cine_curve_empty
text.text: Speed curve: the camera has no block yet (G creates a flight)

text.name: cine_msg_needBlock
text.text: Playback needs at least one block (G creates a flight)

text.name: cine_msg_noRoom
text.text: A new block does not fit here (the next one starts right after)

text.name: cine_msg_modePosition
text.text: The mode sets the camera position in this block – to change the block camera, fly to the spot and press K

text.name: cine_msg_staticMoved
text.text: The block camera now matches your camera: position, direction and focal length

text.name: cine_msg_blockFocal
text.text: Focal length at the block edge: %.0f mm

text.name: cine_msg_keySpeed
text.text: Camera speed at the K-frame: %.1f m/s

text.name: cine_menu_flightAverage
text.text: Constant speed in the block (average %.1f m/s)

text.name: cine_menu_smoothOn
text.text: Blend from the previous block: yes (click: cut)

text.name: cine_menu_smoothOff
text.text: Blend from the previous block: no, cut (click: blend)

text.name: cine_hint_edge
text.text: drag trims the block (the other end stays) | right button block settings

text.name: cine_hint_curveKey
text.text: drag up and down: camera speed at the K-frame | handles sideways: ease in and out | right button K-frame menu

text.name: cine_ch_hintSpeed
text.text: points = flight K-frames: up and down speed, the selected one's handles sideways ease length | red = jerk | right button menu

text.name: cine_msg_noHelper
text.text: The game has no helper, the character was not inserted.

text.name: cine_msg_exitPoint
text.text: The exit point belongs to the get-out action on the timeline (Get in/out lane) and stays at the vehicle. Once the get-out is deleted, it can be deleted together with its whole route part.

text.name: cine_menu_exitManual
text.text: Allow moving the exit point by hand

text.name: cine_menu_exitAuto
text.text: Exit point back to the vehicle (automatic)

text.name: cine_msg_exitManual
text.text: The exit point can now be dragged and no longer snaps to the vehicle. The character gets out at the door and walks to it.

text.name: cine_msg_faceSet
text.text: Character facing: drag the arrow tip at the point (top view, M)

text.name: cine_msg_faceAzimuth
text.text: Point %d: the character faces azimuth %.0f° (Shift = no snapping)

text.name: cine_msg_speedPastEnd
text.text: Speed has no effect after arriving at the end of the route. Add the point before the final zero.

text.name: cine_ch_trimSpeed
text.text: Trim curve to the end of the drive (%d points past the end)

text.name: cine_msg_stopStanding
text.text: The vehicle almost stands here, nothing to stop

text.name: cine_msg_stopLength
text.text: Standing %.1f s, the rest of the drive moved

text.name: cine_ch_routeEnd
text.text: end of route %.1f s - the curve does nothing past it

text.name: cine_msg_speedEndsFixed
text.text: The start and end of the speed curve are fixed (start and arrival at the end of the route).

text.name: cine_props_hint
text.text: reset (R, Play) puts them back where they were remembered

text.name: cine_props_empty
text.text: right-click to add a vehicle, implement, pallet, bale or heap

text.name: cine_prop_addVehicle
text.text: Vehicle, implement or pallet - pick in the scene

text.name: cine_prop_recapture
text.text: Remember how it is now (position, height, amount)

text.name: cine_prop_statusHeap
text.text: reset clears it within %.0f m and tips it again

text.name: cine_msg_pickProp_vehicle
text.text: Click a vehicle, implement or pallet.

text.name: cine_msg_noBale
text.text: There is no bale under the cursor.

text.name: cine_msg_noHeap
text.text: There is no heap under the cursor.

text.name: cine_prop_addField
text.text: Field - click into it (state is taken where you click)

text.name: cine_msg_pickProp_field
text.text: Click into the field where it has the state you want to restore.

text.name: cine_msg_noField
text.text: There is no field under the cursor.

text.name: cine_field_resetOnItem
text.text: Restore fields on reset: on (click to turn off)

text.name: cine_field_resetOffItem
text.text: Restore fields on reset: off (click to turn on)

text.name: cine_field_warnTitle
text.text: Warning: restoring fields changes your game

text.name: cine_field_warn1
text.text: Reset (R, playing from start) sets the fields in the shot to their remembered state.

text.name: cine_field_warn2
text.text: It is a real game change: harvest, plowing and fertilizing are overwritten and saved with the savegame.

text.name: cine_field_warn3
text.text: Better film in a separate savegame or save a copy first.

text.name: cine_msg_fieldsOn
text.text: Restoring fields on reset is on.

text.name: cine_msg_fieldsOff
text.text: Restoring fields on reset is off: fields stay as they are.

text.name: cine_field_windrows
text.text: Windrows of straw, grass or hay…

text.name: cine_field_windrowLoadCp
text.text: Take windrows from a Courseplay course (loaded in a vehicle)

text.name: cine_msg_windrowCp
text.text: Windrows from the Courseplay course: %d segments (%s).

text.name: cine_msg_windrowNoCp
text.text: No vehicle has a Courseplay course loaded for this field: windrows are parallel.

text.name: cine_zone_course
text.text: Harvested along the course: click where the combine got to

text.name: cine_zone_courseHere
text.text: Harvested along the course up to the combines' position

text.name: cine_zone_windrows
text.text: Straw rows only on the harvested part

text.name: cine_zone_lead
text.text: Harvested ahead of the machine centre by: %d m

text.name: cine_field_fastOn
text.text: Fast reset: crop and rows only (soil stays): on

text.name: cine_field_fastOff
text.text: Fast reset: crop and rows only (soil stays): off

text.name: cine_msg_windrowZone
text.text: Rows from the harvested part: %d segments.

text.name: cine_msg_zoneNoCourse
text.text: No machine has a Courseplay course loaded for this field (load it in the machine).

text.name: cine_msg_zoneClickCourse
text.text: Click the Courseplay course (green line) where the combine got to; everything before it becomes harvested. Right button cancels.

text.name: cine_msg_zoneEmpty
text.text: Nothing harvested would be left inside the field.

text.name: cine_msg_zoneCourse
text.text: Harvested along the course: %d segments, %.0f m.

text.name: cine_msg_zoneVehicles
text.text: Harvested up to the combines' position: %d courses, %.0f m.

text.name: cine_msg_zoneRect1
text.text: Rectangle: click the first corner. Right button cancels.

text.name: cine_msg_zoneRect2
text.text: Click the second corner of the same side.

text.name: cine_msg_zoneRect3
text.text: Click the side the rectangle extends to.

text.name: cine_msg_zoneRectBad
text.text: The rectangle is too narrow, start again.

text.name: cine_msg_zoneMax
text.text: Too many zones (at most %d blocks per field).

text.name: cine_msg_propAlready
text.text: This object is already in the list.

text.name: cine_msg_propMissing
text.text: An object is missing in the scene.

text.name: cine_hint_props
text.text: arrow collapses the list | drag the name: moves the group | right-click: add an object

text.name: cine_hint_prop
text.text: right-click: remember position, height, place now, remove

text.name: cine_hint_addActor
text.text: add a vehicle, yourself or a helper to the timeline

text.name: cine_msg_pickActor
text.text: Click the vehicle that should be an actor.

text.name: cine_msg_helperAdded
text.text: %s added. Click from above where they should stand, then click the walking route.

text.name: cine_msg_helperPlaced
text.text: Helper moved to the new spot. Further clicks draw the walking route.

text.name: cine_msg_routePointAdded
text.text: Route point %d added (right click in the scene; select the Camera row for camera keys)

text.name: cine_msg_noWardrobe
text.text: The game wardrobe cannot be opened here.
